description: Probation, contract alerts and the letters' signatories for Luuka's onboarding.

fields.label: Probation Period (Months)
fields.description: The End of Probation date of a new employee: the joining date plus this.

fields.label: Extension (Months)
fields.description: How long an extended probation runs, unless the Executive Director sets another date.

fields.label: Pass Mark
fields.description: The total score a probation evaluation must reach. To be confirmed by Luuka: the form's bands put Average at 50-59%.

fields.label: Employment Type on Confirmation
fields.description: Optional: the Employee's Employment Type once confirmed, e.g. Permanent.

fields.label: Contract Alerts (Days Before the End)
fields.description: The HR Officer is told this many days before a contract ends: a year, a quarter and a month.

fields.label: Executive Director
fields.description: Signs the Confirmation in Service and Contract Renewal letters.

fields.label: Head of Human Resources
fields.description: Signs the Expiry of Contract letter.

name: Onboarding Settings
